title: Clay Creature Studio
shareTitle: Clay Creature Studio — Make a Clay Friend
description: Build or decorate a clay creature with 56 draggable parts, choose a talking mouth, then wake it for a lip-synced surprise and save it locally.
learningGoals: Compose a character from movable visual parts
Practice visual-spatial observation by copying a picture card
Build creative confidence through open-ended design
interactionModel: Swipe one continuous full-width clay tray or page it with clay arrows; drag parts edge-to-edge, live-flip directional pieces at the figure median, and discard in clay trash. Blob bodies are assembled from clay balls before decoration.
feedbackModel: Every clay part squishes and pops into the composition; completed creatures wake with animation, confetti, one of 40 caller-voice phrases, and canonical viseme lip sync.
